title: 第91章 阵眼突袭直取首领第90章 僵持不下战局胶着
slug: 朽道归墟我以残灵证长生
lines: 擂台战局僵持至此，大势早已悄然倾覆。
漫天灵力硝烟尚未散尽，破碎的灵玉碎屑悬浮半空，被紊乱的灵气气流裹挟着缓缓打转。整片擂台满目疮痍，纵横交错的裂痕如同干涸大地的沟壑，贯穿整座战台，每一道裂隙深处都淤积着浓郁暗沉的灰色朽纹。黑白灵力湮灭过后的余温炙烤着空气，混杂着淡淡的血腥与腐朽气息，笼罩全场，压得数万围观弟子心神窒息、呼吸凝滞。
江辰伫立擂台东侧，身形摇摇欲坠，早已没了半分天骄气度。
历经无尽回合的亡命猛攻、透支拉锯，他的肉身、经脉、道基已然濒临崩毁极限。周身纯白正统灵气斑驳黯淡、断续紊乱，再也无法维系连贯流转，体表蔓延的灰黑色朽毒纹路彻底爬满四肢躯干，顺着经脉扎根丹田道基深处。肉眼可见的干瘪衰败迹象浮现皮肉表层，昔日饱满充盈的生机飞速流逝，整个人如同被抽走本源、掏空根基的枯木，外强中干、岌岌可危。
可他依旧死死攥紧残破的本命灵剑，指节发白、虎口崩血，凭着刻入骨髓的骄傲与执念强行撑住身形，不肯屈膝、不肯认输、不肯正视自己毕生信奉的大道早已腐朽崩坏的残酷真相。赤红的眼眸死死锁定前方，残存的战意带着疯狂的偏执，依旧想要冲破桎梏、镇压对手，挽回正统大道的颜面。
但他所有的挣扎、所有的反扑，终究只是徒劳的垂死挣扎。
擂台西侧，林寂静立未动，身姿清挺如松，稳若磐石。
数十回合的极限拉锯，他肉身虽有浅浅剑伤、衣袂尽数破损，却全然无碍根基。恰恰相反，整场持久战催生的海量腐朽道痕，尽数被他丹田朽道熔炉吞噬熔炼、提纯转化。原本卡在归墟境巅峰许久的修为壁垒，在源源不断的逆道本源滋养下，早已松动破碎、薄如蝉翼，肉身筋骨、经脉韧性、神魂强度尽数完成迭代蜕变。
他周身流转的灰色朽气愈发凝练纯粹、内敛厚重，没有此前那般张扬凌厉，却自带一股镇压万物、逆伐天道的深沉威压。每一缕气息流转，都带着拆解正统、湮灭伪道的本源特性，无声震慑着整片擂台空间。
一衰一盛，一枯一荣。
极致悬殊的状态反差，赤裸裸展现在数万弟子眼前，无需多言辩驳，便彻底击碎了正统无敌的万古执念。台下原本压抑的死寂被细碎的哗然取代，无数弟子交头接耳、神色震动，眼底的迷茫与疑虑彻底生根发芽，根深蒂固的道心已然出现巨大裂痕。
主峰看台之上，三位金丹长老面色阴沉如水，周身气压低至冰点，眼底翻涌着极致的震怒与忌惮。
他们最不愿看到的局面，终究还是发生了。
正统天骄承载宗门道运、倾尽底蕴加持，却在堂堂正正的擂台对决中，被一名归墟境异类逆道修士活活耗垮、生生压制。万古传承的正统大道，在朽道逆力面前尽显虚妄孱弱，万年维系的道统荣光，在万众瞩目之下轰然龟裂、摇摇欲坠。
再任由战局这般延续下去，不用林寂出手绝杀，江辰便会自行朽毒爆发、道基崩碎。届时全宗弟子亲眼目睹天骄腐朽、正统崩塌，积攒万年的道统信仰将会彻底崩盘，青玄宗的根基将彻底动摇。
绝不能让此事发生！
李千绝双目寒芒暴涨，低沉冷厉的嗓音带着不容置疑的威严，骤然响彻主峰看台：“结阵！”
一声令下，早已蛰伏在擂台四方、隐匿于人群侧翼的数十名核心内门弟子、宗门精锐执事瞬间动了。
这批人手皆是宗门精心挑选的正统修士，修为尽数抵达凝气巅峰、归墟境层次，常年配合演练合击阵法，默契无间、招式规整，是高层预留的后手，专为今日镇压林寂、挽回正统颓势而备。
刹那之间，数十道纯白灵气光柱冲天而起，纵横交错、串联天穹，精准落位擂台四方八极。道道正统道纹自地面升腾、沿空蔓延，飞快衔接、层层叠加，瞬间编织成一张覆盖整座擂台的巨型禁锢阵图。
天地灵气疯狂被阵法牵引汇聚，纯白光幕垂落而下，封锁擂台所有空间，隔绝内外气流、隔断一切退路。厚重磅礴的镇道威压席卷全场，带着天道规则的束缚之力、宗门正统的镇压之势，死死锁定擂台中央的林寂。
“玄天镇邪大阵！”
台下有资历深厚的长老弟子一眼认出阵法来路，神色骤然剧变，满脸震惊。
此阵乃是青玄宗镇宗合击大阵之一，需三十六名精锐修士同心同力、引动正统道纹方可催动，专为镇压异端、净化邪力而生。阵法成型可锁空间、封灵力、镇邪祟、困神魂，层层天道禁锢叠加，哪怕是金丹初期强者深陷其中，也会被层层压制、耗死阵中，威力恐怖、禁锢无双。
显然，三位金丹长老已然彻底撕破脸皮，不再执着于公平对决、擂台规矩，决意动用宗门合击大阵，以绝对人数、阵法之力强行镇压林寂，强行终结这场颠覆道统的对决，挽回濒临崩塌的正统颜面。
三十六名阵修分立八方、脚踏阵位、手掐法诀，身形规整、纹丝不动，源源不断将自身灵力灌入阵纹之中，维系大阵运转。道道厚重的灵力光幕层层下压，阵内空间不断收缩、禁锢之力持续攀升，无数锋利的正统灵力刃纹在阵中穿梭游走，密密麻麻、无处不在，锁定林寂周身所有方位。
“邪魔外道，祸乱宗门！”
“背弃正统、亵渎天道，今日必镇杀你于擂台之上，以正道统！”
阵外阵修齐声暴喝，声震长空、气势汹汹，配合大阵浩荡威势，试图以声势、威压、正统名分彻底击溃林寂的心境防线，将他彻底钉死在邪修的耻辱柱上。
层层禁锢、重重杀机、八方围堵。
在所有人看来，林寂已然身陷必死之局，插翅难飞、无路可逃。孤身一人，对阵宗门精锐合击大阵、身负天道镇邪威压、外加残血天骄牵制，无论战力多强、逆道多诡，终究无力回天。
可擂台中央，深陷大阵包围的林寂，神色依旧淡然无波，眼底没有半分慌乱畏惧，只剩一片澄澈冰冷。
他静静伫立阵心，朽道真眼全开，漆黑的眼眸穿透层层纯白光幕、繁复阵纹，瞬间洞悉整座玄天镇邪大阵的运转机理、能量脉络、虚实破绽。
但凡阵法，皆有核心。
content_en:
The battle situation in the arena has reached a stalemate, and the situation has already been quietly overturned.
The smoke of spiritual energy in the sky has not yet dissipated, and the broken spiritual jade fragments are suspended in the air, being wrapped up in the chaotic spiritual energy flow and slowly spinning. The entire arena was devastated, with criss-crossing cracks like ravines on the dry earth, running through the entire arena, and deep in each crack there was thick, dark gray decay. The remaining warmth after the black and white spiritual power was annihilated burned the air, mixed with a faint smell of blood and decay, and enveloped the entire place, suffocating the minds and stagnating the breath of tens of thousands of onlookers.
Jiang Chen stood on the east side of the arena, his figure was shaky, and he had already lost half of his arrogance.
After endless rounds of desperate attacks and overdrafts, his body, meridians, and foundation were on the verge of collapse. The pure white orthodox spiritual energy all over his body was mottled, dim, intermittent and chaotic, and could no longer maintain a coherent flow. The gray-black rotten poison lines spreading on the body surface completely covered the limbs and trunk, and took root deep in the Dantian Daoji along the meridians. Visible signs of dryness and decay appear on the surface of the skin. The once full and full vitality is rapidly passing away. The whole person is like a dead tree that has been drained of its origin and hollowed out its foundation. It is strong on the outside and dry on the inside, and is in danger.
But he still clutched the broken natal spiritual sword tightly, his knuckles turned white, and the jaws were bleeding. He relied on the pride and obsession engraved in his bones to hold himself up, refusing to bend his knees, admit defeat, and face the cruel truth that the avenue he believed in all his life had long since decayed and collapsed. The red eyes were fixed on the front, and the remaining fighting spirit was filled with crazy paranoia, still wanting to break through the shackles, suppress the opponent, and save the face of the orthodox road.
But all his struggles and counterattacks were ultimately just a futile death struggle.
On the west side of the arena, Lin Jingjing stood still, his posture as straight as a pine and as steady as a rock.
After dozens of rounds of extreme tug-of-war, even though his body had slight sword wounds and all his clothes were damaged, his foundation was completely intact. On the contrary, the massive traces of decay created by the entire protracted battle were all devoured, smelted, purified and transformed by his Dantian decay furnace. The cultivation barrier that was originally stuck at the peak of the Guixu Realm for a long time has been loosened and shattered, as thin as cicada wings, under the constant nourishment of the reverse path source. The physical muscles, the toughness of the meridians, and the strength of the soul have all completed iterative transformations.
The gray rotten energy flowing around him became more condensed, pure, restrained and thick. It was not as overt and fierce as before, but it carried a deep coercion that suppressed all things and rebelled against the way of heaven. Every breath that flows carries the original characteristics of dismantling orthodoxy and annihilating false ways, silently shocking the entire arena space.
One declines and the other prospers, one withers and the other prospers.
The extremely disparate state contrast was nakedly displayed in front of tens of thousands of disciples. Without any need to argue, it completely shattered the eternal obsession of orthodoxy with invincibility. The originally oppressive silence in the audience was replaced by a small uproar. Countless disciples whispered to each other and looked shocked. The confusion and doubts in their eyes had completely taken root. Huge cracks had appeared in their deep-rooted Taoist hearts.
On the grandstand of the main peak, the faces of the three Jindan elders were as gloomy as water, the air pressure around their bodies was as low as freezing point, and their eyes were filled with extreme anger and fear.
The situation they least wanted to see happened eventually.
The orthodox genius carried the sect's destiny and devoted all his resources to support him. However, in the upright arena duel, he was exhausted and suppressed by an alien cultivator from the Ruins Realm. The orthodox Taoist tradition that has been passed down through the ages is completely vain and weak in the face of the counter-force of the decayed Tao. The glory of the Taoist tradition that has been maintained for thousands of years is cracking and crumbling under the gaze of everyone.
If the battle is allowed to continue like this, without Lin Ji making a decisive move, Jiang Chen will explode on his own and the foundation of the road will collapse. At that time, all the disciples of the sect will witness with their own eyes the decay of Tianjiao and the collapse of orthodoxy. The orthodox belief accumulated for thousands of years will completely collapse and the foundation of Qingxuan Sect will be completely shaken.
We must not let this happen!
Li Qianjue's eyes suddenly turned cold, and his deep and cold voice, with unquestionable majesty, suddenly resounded through the main summit stands: "Form up!"
With an order, the dozens of core inner disciples and elite deacons of the sect who had been dormant in all directions of the arena and hidden on the flanks of the crowd moved instantly.
This group of people are all orthodox monks carefully selected by the sect. Their cultivation has reached the peak of Qi Condensation and the level of returning to the ruins. They have been practicing joint attack formations together all year round. They have a tacit understanding and regular moves. They are the back-ups reserved by the top management. They are specially prepared to suppress Lin Ji and restore the decline of orthodoxy today.
In an instant, dozens of pure white spiritual energy light pillars soared into the sky, criss-crossing and connecting the sky, and accurately positioned in all directions of the arena. The orthodox Dao patterns rose from the ground and spread along the air. They quickly connected and overlapped layer by layer, instantly weaving into a giant confinement formation covering the entire arena.
The spiritual energy of heaven and earth was drawn together by the formation like crazy, and the pure white light curtain fell down, sealing off all the space in the arena, isolating the internal and external airflow, and cutting off all escape routes. Thick and majestic pressure swept across the entire arena, with the restraining power of heaven's rules and the suppressive force of sect orthodoxy, locking Lin Ji in the center of the ring.
"Xuantian Evil Suppressing Formation!"
There were experienced elders and disciples in the audience who recognized the origin of the formation at a glance, and their expressions suddenly changed, with shock on their faces.
This formation is one of the Qingxuan Sect's sect-suppressing joint attack formations. It requires thirty-six elite monks to work together and activate the orthodox Dao patterns before it can be activated. It is specially created to suppress heretics and purify evil forces. The formation of the formation can lock space, seal spiritual power, suppress evil spirits, and trap souls. The layers of heavenly imprisonment are superimposed. Even a strong person in the early stage of the golden elixir will be suppressed and consumed in the formation layer by layer. The power is terrifying and the imprisonment is unparalleled.
Obviously, the three Jindan elders had completely lost their skin. They no longer insisted on a fair duel and the rules of the arena, and decided to use the sect's joint attack formation to suppress Lin Ji with the sheer force of their numbers and formations. They forcibly ended this duel that overturned the orthodoxy and restored the face of orthodoxy that was on the verge of collapse.
Thirty-six formation cultivators are standing in all directions, with their feet on the formation and their hands pinching spells. Their bodies are regular and motionless, and they are constantly pouring their spiritual power into the formation pattern to maintain the operation of the formation. Thick spiritual power light curtains pressed down layer by layer, the space within the array continued to shrink, and the power of confinement continued to rise. Countless sharp orthodox spiritual power blade patterns shuttled through the array, densely packed and everywhere, locking in all directions around Lin Ji's body.
"Evil heretics are causing trouble to the sect!"
"For betraying the orthodoxy and blaspheming the way of heaven, I will kill you on the stage today to uphold the orthodoxy!"
The cultivators outside the formation shouted loudly in unison, their voices filling the sky with ferocious momentum. In conjunction with the majestic power of the formation, they tried to use their momentum, coercion, and legitimacy to completely defeat Lin Ji's mental defense and nail him to the pillar of shame of evil cultivators.
Layers of imprisonment, heavy murderous intent, and containment from all sides.
In everyone's eyes, Lin Ji was already trapped in a certain death situation, with no wings to fly and no way to escape. Alone, facing the sect's elite attack formation, burdened with the pressure of heaven to suppress evil, and restrained by the genius with residual blood, no matter how strong the fighting force is, and how treacherous the evil path is, there is no way to save him.
But in the center of the arena, Lin Ji, who was surrounded by a large formation, still looked calm and calm. There was no trace of panic or fear in his eyes, only a clear and cold look.
He stood quietly in the center of the formation, with his True Eyes fully open. His dark eyes penetrated the layers of pure white light curtains and complex formation patterns, and instantly understood the operating mechanism, energy veins, and flaws of the entire Xuantian Evil Suppressing Formation.
All formations have a core.
title_en: Chapter 91: A surprise attack at the center of the formation to capture the leader Chapter 90: A stalemate leads to a stalemate
